description: This file defines a CalculatorService class extending a base Service, which registers 'add' and 'sub' methods, and it initializes a ServiceManager instance to register the service and connect to a server.

classes.name: CalculatorService
classes.description: A service providing basic calculator functionalities 'add' and 'sub', registered with the Service framework.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of parameters and resolves the promise with the result.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between the first two parameters and resolves the promise with the result.
